title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-09
source: Sony ECM-220T mics > Sony TC-D5M > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience recording of Frost’s Oct ’82 show captures a smoking set with standout Estimated Prophet → Eyes jam and tight first‑set flow.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently high‑energy, featuring a uniformly stellar first set and a second set that never lets up – the Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World sequence is repeatedly called “killer.”  The Rango audience (AUD) source is praised for its crisp balance, with only minor issues like recessed drums and a touch‑less Phil bass, making this one of the best audience tapes available.

ai_rating.rationale: Nearly all reviewers give 4–5 stars, highlighting an exceptional show and excellent (audience) recording quality with only minor technical quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp balance; Bob Weir’s guitar front‑and‑center. Drums are a bit recessed (often need EQ boost). Phil’s bass lacks a little definition but overall very good.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, uniformly stellar first set followed by a seamless second set; the Estimated Prophet → Eyes transition flows beautifully and keeps momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Energetic vocals and guitar work praised – rousing Deal, spot‑on US Blues lyrics, overall fire.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass solid but could use a bit more definition; otherwise good foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythm guitar is mixed front‑and‑center throughout, noted as either a highlight or a noticeable presence.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are slightly buried in the mix; listeners often need to boost mids/highs to hear them clearly.
